card.name: Self-discipline and habit advice
card.fires_on: Words in self-help text about habits, procrastination and willpower, often right after verbs like promise, remind, motivate or procrastinate. It also fires on the next word, such as ourselves, to, the or your.

modes.label: Reflexive after self-motivation verbs
modes.description: A word like ourselves or himself right after a verb of promising, reminding or motivating.
modes.example: Often, our New Year’s resolutions are us promising<< ourselves>> we’ll form good habits this year:

modes.label: Procrastination and habit-tip wording
modes.description: A word inside advice about procrastinating, remembering tasks or building routines.
modes.example: However, at times, you will<< procrast>>inate and resume your browsing.

modes.label: Small words in habit tips
modes.description: A small word such as to, the or your within a tip for building a habit.
modes.example: Put<< the>> floss in a conspicuous place by your

card.writes: It leans toward self-directed or reflexive wording, but the promoted tokens are mixed and the suppressed ones are reflexives like yourself, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in self-help writing about habits, willpower and putting off tasks.
